# Downtime Protocols & Common Rules

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
from sr6core.log_engine import get_log_totals
from sr6core.character_manager import CharacterManager
from sr6core.rules_engine import get_matrix_protocols_summary

cm = CharacterManager()
_char = cm.get_character_data("reiko") or cm.get_character_data("yuriko") or {}
attrs = _char.get("attributes", {})
log_totals = get_log_totals(["core/character_log.qmd", "core/character_purchases.qmd"])

SUBMERSION_GRADE = log_totals.get("Submersion_Grade", 8)
edge_storage = 5 + SUBMERSION_GRADE

matrix_summary = get_matrix_protocols_summary("reiko")
active_asdf = matrix_summary.get("asdf_str", "A:7 S:9 D:7 F:9").replace("A:", "").replace(" S:", "").replace(" D:", "").replace(" F:", "")
full_def_hits = matrix_summary.get("full_defense_hits", 8)
full_def_pool = matrix_summary.get("full_defense_pool", 34)
```

This landing hub consolidates Reiko's downtime protocols, calculation shortcuts, and mechanics cheat sheets across four dedicated domain references.

## Domain Protocol Directories

Select a domain reference for full formulas, dice pool breakdowns, step-by-step downtime guides, and action tables:

1. **[Matrix & Network Protocols](rules_matrix.qmd)**: Base & Active ASDF attributes, standardized Matrix action pools, network benefits, learned programs, Full Matrix Defense step-by-step breakdown, remote node & Sanctuary Host architecture, and decking cheat sheet.
2. **[Sprites & Resonance Protocols](rules_sprites.qmd)**: Active Registered Sprite Stable, 2nd generation sparks downtime rotation, Complex Forms roster, step-by-step compiling & registering downtime math, Technoshaman fading mitigation, and Resonance Focus protocols.
3. **[Drones & Rigging Protocols](rules_drones.qmd)**: Detailed drone stat blocks (Shiawase Man-at-Arms, MCT Gnat), retractable skates rules, standardized drone action pools, Jumped-In vs Remote AI attribute mapping rules, and Sensor Lock mechanics.
4. **[Weapons & Tactical Gear Protocols](rules_combat.qmd)**: Standardized weapon attack tables (Red Fox array & single mode, Tesla Coil, Amalgam Cestas), firing mode rules, Attack Rating modification breakdown, and laser battery rules.
